{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
cleaned_data = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Count final number of completed orders
final_count = len(cleaned_data)
print(f"Final number of completed orders after removing QA: {final_count}")

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = cleaned_data.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum().reset_index()
print(f"Total revenue by channel:\n{total_revenue_by_channel}")

# Find the channel with highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue'].idxmax()]
print(f"Best channel: {best_channel['channel']} with revenue: {best_channel['revenue']:.2f}")"}
